name: ORBIT 5
source:
YOU have been placed on a ship within the stars. There is no escape. You have one companion - Doctor Polyakov, captain of PERSEUS - SALVATION UNIT. You have five days to get home, lest you and your species perish.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4134020/ORBIT_5/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你被安置在一艘星际飞船上。无处可逃。你有一位同伴 - 波利亚科夫博士，珀尔修斯号 - 拯救部队的船长。你有五天的时间回家，以免你和你的物种灭亡。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4134020/ORBIT_5/]Steam[/url]]
